boundaries.name: plonky2_refinement
boundaries.obligation: The handwritten gate equations (CircuitGates, WrapGates), the builder/prover/verifier programs and the registered public-input vector must be linked to actual plonky2 compilation, proving and verification; none of that lowering is discharged here.

boundaries.name: consumer_vd_pin
boundaries.obligation: On the initial step new_pis.vd is a free virtual verifier data (theorem initial_step_vd_unconstrained) and every continued step forwards it unchanged (chain_declares_single_vd). Only a consumer pins it to the real chain verifier data: DepositHashChainCircuit::verify -> check_cyclic_proof_verifier_data (modeled as chain_verify_pins_declared_vd) or block_step.rs add_proof_target_and_conditionally_verify_cyclic, which is outside the modeled files and must be audited there.

boundaries.name: field_and_gadget_lowering
boundaries.obligation: Goldilocks arithmetic, split_le, range_check, select, the keccak and Poseidon gadgets, DepositMerkleProofTarget and from_pis slicing are modeled as Nat equations over lists. Their circuit lowering, and in particular that split_le(prev_count, 63) is what bounds the previous count below 2^63, is assumed.

boundaries.name: vd_canonicity
boundaries.obligation: vd_from_pis_slice / vd_from_pis_slice_target read verifier-data field elements from u64 public inputs with no canonicity check; verifier-data words are carried as an opaque List Nat and compared only for equality.

boundaries.name: u64_to_field_reduction
boundaries.obligation: from_u64_slice reads the proof's public inputs after ToU64 conversion of field elements, and vd_from_pis_slice converts them back with to_field_vec. The model works with Nat words and assumes that round trip is the identity on the values a real proof can carry.

boundaries.name: poseidon_root_words_unchecked
boundaries.obligation: Neither from_u64_slice nor DepositChainPublicInputsTarget::new range-checks the two Poseidon tree-root words (theorem parse_root_words_not_range_checked). Any constraint on them must come from the Poseidon gadget that consumes them, which is outside this file.

boundaries.name: two_serializations_agree
boundaries.obligation: to_u64_vec and to_vec are two independently hand-written field orders in the source; the model collapses them into one layout function (PublicInputs.words). Their agreement, and their agreement with from_u64_slice / from_pis cursor arithmetic, is assumed rather than proved against the Rust code.
